description: Implementation of ProductAttributeDao for database operations related to ProductAttribute entities, including methods for retrieving product attributes by various criteria using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductAttribute, providing methods to query product attributes from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its ID, fetching related entities via QueryDSL.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific MerchantStore and Option ID.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs for a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes associated with a specific Option Value ID for a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes for a given Product, MerchantStore, and Language.
